chirality_and_mirror_rank.compactness_obstruction: A globally smooth exact Cartan Witten/deRham complex on a closed 3-manifold has signed index zero. A noncompact local index -3 needs compensating +3 or changing smooth/closed/exact assumptions. This DOES NOT forbid singular/flux compactifications.
chirality_and_mirror_rank.rank_proof: Y=e_star v.T+v e_star.T has rank<=2. For any 6x3 light-family embedding N (including generic mixing with three mirrors), Y_light=N.T Y N has rank<=2. Higgs-independent linear vectorlike decoupling cannot lift it.
chirality_and_mirror_rank.U1_conclusion: Using the local source anomaly values, the only line canceling both mixed anomalies has nonzero pure cubic, so no additional massless anomaly-free U1 combination of these three without spectrum changes or inflow.
chirality_and_mirror_rank.limits: Local net3 and anomalies are inputs from d67b942, not independently recomputed here. Compact index theorem applies to a smooth exact Witten/deRham complex, not a general singular chiral 7D model. Yukawa obstruction applies to bare Higgs-linear star texture with Higgs-independent mirror mixing, not all higher-dimensional operators.

asymptotically_free_parent.UV_gauge: N=1 SU4, Nf10 vectorlike fundamentals plus antifundamentals
asymptotically_free_parent.Higgsing_pattern: SU4 -> SU3 with one vectorlike flavor VEV; nine pairs remain
asymptotically_free_parent.critical_missing_step: A UV-complete holomorphic gauge-invariant F-flat superpotential naturally selecting the SIC and a scale hierarchy, plus matching of heavy fields/thresholds and SM survival. A quartic SU4 baryon is nonrenormalizable without mediators.

worldsheet_covariance_benchmark.target: Parametrized free string in flat 1+1 target, first-class classical Hamiltonian and diffeomorphism constraints
worldsheet_covariance_benchmark.finite_local_derivation_no_go: C^n pointwise derivations zero; even low-mode spectral exactness is not full off-shell finite-grid closure.
worldsheet_covariance_benchmark.limits: A covariant worldsheet benchmark with fixed target Minkowski metric, not field-dependent 3+1 Einstein gravity; discrete tests assess sampled brackets, not all 3 constraints universally.

single_photon_and_qutrit_resources.single_photon_mode_capacity: An arbitrary n-qubit pure register has Hilbert dimension 2^n; a single photon restricted to M orthogonal modes has dim M. Exact faithful encoding requires M>=2^n.
single_photon_and_qutrit_resources.time_bin_1ns_assumption: Duration bound applies only to sequential nonoverlapping time bins with >=1 ns separation, not general frequency/OAM multiplexing.
single_photon_and_qutrit_resources.one_photon_scalability_caveat: Cannot claim polynomial-resource BQP on n logical qubits by relabeling 2^n single-photon modes as qubits; continuous-variable addressing may hide exponential precision/bandwidth costs. Additional photons/nonlinearities/encoding assumptions can change the model.
single_photon_and_qutrit_resources.T9_boundaries: This reproduces a known unencoded qudit Clifford feed-forward identity; it is NOT an encoded, fault-tolerant universal computation protocol.

SM_coupling_running.physics_requirement: A claimed unification must output thresholds/particle spectrum and two-loop matching, then reproduce all three measured couplings. Matching finite-group dimensions or a single alpha is insufficient.
